name: Omer Gull
biography: Omer Gull is a vulnerability researcher in the Malware and Vulnerability Research group at Check Point Software Technologies. Omer has a diverse background in security research, that includes web application penetration testing, RE and exploitation. He loves Rum, Old School Hip-Hop and Memory Corruptions.
